links.outcome: Eyelid measurement error by site and imaging device (DSLR internal vs smartphone external)
links.effect: Internal (DSLR): MRD1 PCC 0.98, MAPE 5.69%; MRD2 PCC 0.94, MAPE 4.57%. External (smartphone): MRD1 PCC 0.94, MAPE 9.06%; MRD2 PCC 0.93, MAPE 15.07%.
links.quote: Although MRD2 showed a slightly higher MAPE (15.07%), likely due to manual measurement variability in clinical records, the correlation remained strong (PCC 0.93).

unlisted_practices: Marker-free calibration using population-specific corneal diameter as an intrinsic reference scale

screen.reason: Multicenter retrospective external validation of deep learning-based eyelid segmentation software ('Glandy LID') across clinical cohorts without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
